# Rays Academy

> Rays Academy is a trusted coaching institute in Bhopal, India (est. 2006). It offers school coaching for classes 6–12 (CBSE, ICSE, MP Board) and entrance preparation for IIT-JEE, NEET, NDA, CUET and Olympiads.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Rays Academy, admissions, highlights and results.
- [About](/about): History, founder Shankar Lal Amulani, facilities and teaching approach.
- [Courses](/courses): All coaching programs offered, school and competitive.
- [Faculty](/faculty): Subject experts and senior teachers.
- [Results](/results): Board toppers, JEE/NEET selections and year-wise outcomes.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Campus, classrooms, events and student achievements.
- [Contact](/contact): Address, phone, WhatsApp and admission enquiry form.
- [Scholarship Test (RSAT)](/rsat): Rays Scholarship & Aptitude Test details.
- [Study Material](/study-material): Notes, NCERT solutions, sample papers, PYQs and revision resources.

## Courses

- [Class 6–8 Foundation](/courses/class-6-8): Foundation coaching in Maths, Science and English.
- [Class 9](/courses/class-9): Board preparation with concept clarity.
- [Class 10](/courses/class-10): CBSE, ICSE and MP Board boards coaching.
- [Class 11](/courses/class-11): PCM / PCB with integrated entrance prep.
- [Class 12](/courses/class-12): Boards plus IIT-JEE/NEET preparation.
- [IIT-JEE](/courses/iit-jee): JEE Main and Advanced coaching in Bhopal.
- [NEET](/courses/neet): Medical entrance preparation with NCERT focus.
- [NDA](/courses/nda): Defence exam written and SSB interview prep.
- [CUET](/courses/cuet): Central university entrance coaching for all streams.
